summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.83/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.83 a gallon across Wisconsin as of August 16, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 4¢ higher than a week ago, 27¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.05 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.58) and the highest in Superior ($4.07).
